_note: topics: what a contact can help with. name = heading in 'Who to Ask', link = project note in the vault, regex = match in company or position, sectors = every contact in these sectors belongs to the topic. Claude generates this file from your projects during the path. 'sectors' and 'message_topics' are optional; the script has defaults. Exclusions: exclude_lastnames (e.g. family), exclude_people (full names), exclude_organizations (regex on company), exclude_sectors (whole sectors, e.g. "Health & Medicine"). Excluded contacts are never written; notes imported earlier are not deleted. description: one sentence on what the topic is about and what kind of help is wanted; Claude uses it when sorting contacts (classify.py).
